name: in-a-grove
description: In a Grove (Oink Games, Revised 2021) — realtime online fan version

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,red "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && tsc --noEmit -p client
